description: The bar chart titled “Recall@10” presents an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of four different configurations of a conversation recommendation system based on a generative reward model and simulated user. The horizontal axis lists the four configurations: “Ours” (the full proposed method), “- critiquing” (without attribute-based item critiquing), “- scoring” (without generative item scoring), and “- ranking” (without efficient candidate ranking). The vertical axis represents Recall@10, ranging from 0.1 to 0.4 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The “Ours” bar, colored orange, reaches approximately 0.35, indicating the highest performance. The three ablated versions, all colored blue, show lower performance: “- critiquing” is at about 0.29, “- scoring” is the lowest at roughly 0.17, and “- ranking” is at approximately 0.23. The bars are arranged left to right in descending order of performance, visually emphasizing the contribution of each component, with the removal of “scoring” having the most detrimental effect on Recall@10.
